name: tumbletown-playground
description: Pre-launch marketing site for a (fictional) indoor playground: plain HTML/CSS, Netlify Forms, hosted-checkout payments, self-enforcing launch gates.

paragraphs: A pre-launch marketing site for a family-owned indoor playground (ages 1 to 12). It has ten pages, three working forms, hosted-checkout payments, and a launch process that guards itself. It uses no framework and no dependencies, and it has no build toolchain to rot.

About this repository. I built this for a real small-business client. The client went with an all-in-one venue platform instead, so I have published the work with every identifying detail replaced. Tumbletown, Maya Lindqvist and the family story are fictional, the logo is a stand-in, and example.com stands in for the domain. The code, structure, commit history and engineering decisions are all unchanged.

This site will outlive whoever maintains it next. A brochure site with a toolchain is a site that stops building in two years when a transitive dependency breaks, and the person holding it is a playground owner, not a developer. Nothing here needs npm, and nothing here can rot.
